description: A Kubernetes web UI that is fully-featured, user-friendly and extensible

summary.one_liner: Headlamp is an easy-to-use, extensible web UI for Kubernetes that can run in-cluster or as a local desktop app.
summary.what_it_does: Headlamp lists and views Kubernetes resources, in the style of traditional web dashboards, and adds further functionality on top. It is described as vendor-independent and works both inside a cluster and locally as a desktop application. It supports multiple clusters and uses RBAC so that UI controls reflect the user's permissions, hiding or disabling delete and update actions the user cannot perform. Operations such as creating, updating, and deleting resources can be cancelled, and it offers logs, exec, and a resource editor. Functionality can be extended through plugins, which are published on Artifact Hub and in an official plugins repository.
use_cases: browse and inspect Kubernetes resources in a web interface
view pod logs and exec into containers from a UI
manage multiple Kubernetes clusters from one dashboard
run a Kubernetes dashboard as a local desktop app
deploy a Kubernetes web UI inside a cluster
extend a Kubernetes dashboard with custom plugins
how_to_run: Deploy in-cluster: follow the in-cluster instructions in the project documentation
Desktop app: install the Linux, Mac, or Windows desktop application from the project's release links
Ensure a kubeconfig file exists at the default path so Headlamp can read your clusters
For development: see the Contributing Guidelines and Development Guide for building from source
notable: Runs both in-cluster and as a local desktop application
UI controls adapt to the user's RBAC permissions
Plugin system with plugins published on Artifact Hub
Project moved under Kubernetes SIG UI (kubernetes-sigs org)
caveats: Desktop app requires an existing kubeconfig file in the default path
Users with very limited tokens may not see cluster resources correctly due to RBAC
README notes possible broken links during the recent repository move
